reviews.text:
Believe in Dog is not just good. It is singular.

No one loves dogs more than the people here do, and your dog will love them right back. It’s a common joke in our house that we occupy a comfortable third place on Caper’s list of favorite people, behind his favorite BID trainers. That feels fair. They have poured so much care, attention, and thought into his well-being that it is honestly kind of unbelievable.

They taught Caper everything he knows, but that was probably the easy part. We were first-time dog owners, and they taught us how to be good at that too. They guided us with enormous patience and with a level of competence across the entire staff that is, in itself, a tremendous accomplishment. There was never a sense thatthe quality of the experience depended on getting the “right” trainer or the “right” person that day. Everyone knew what they were doing, everyone cared, and everyone seemed deeply invested in helping both dogs and their anxious humans succeed.

Beyond their obvious love of dogs and seemingly endless knowledge, this may also be the best-run business I have ever seen. Stephanie and Joanna should teach a workshop. Believe in Dog puts the lie to the assumption that consistency requires bland corporate sameness. They have somehow built a place that is highly reliable and professional while still feeling completely human. The facilities are beautiful and, in our experience, absolutely unmatched. The service is consistently excellent. And the individual staff members who make the place special seem genuinely supported in bringing their own talents, judgment, and kindness to the work.

We did puppy school, daycare, and classes here, and every class leader and assistant we worked with was excellent. The staff have an extraordinary combination of talent with dogs and gentleness with the people attached to them. They are truly all so impressive.

We miss Believe in Dog enormously since moving away, and we will always be grateful for what they did for us and for our puppy. They turned the three of us into a proper, inseparable pack. They gave us the ability to communicate across species, to understand and enjoy one another more fully, and somehow made the process of getting there rewarding in its own right.

There is nowhere else quite like this place. Thank you BID!
We just finished our dog training.  Both Valeria and Alyssa "AV" were fantastic! Our dog has learned so much and now we just have to practice more.  Thanks for all your help!!

It is literally impossible to say enough good things about Believe in Dog. Our dog Caper started going to puppy day school when he was just 12 weeks old and continued through graduation and into the daycare program. We also did puppy classes and some other workshops. We absolutely credit Believe in Dog with making Caper into the sweet, friendly, outgoing boy he is today. Puppy day school is not just a daycare, it really is like preschool for your dog. Caper learned socialization, new skills, and had an absolute blast every time. The staff are trainers who really understand dogs, and Caper’s days were packed with activities, training, and supervised playtime. We are first time dog owners, and it was so comforting to have the trainers’ support every step of the way. The staff at Believe in Dog were patient with all our questions and are clearly incredibly invested in all of the dogs they help care for. It is definitely not cheap, but you get what you pay for and for us it was 100% worth it. A special shout out to Mar, Jae, Ashley, and Joanna who all showered Caper in love. I am 100% confident that no other dog daycare will ever compare. We recently moved out of Houston but otherwise Caper would still be a regular. We miss Believe in Dog every day!

I came in last Saturday not knowing there was an enrichment day event and felt as though it was extremely busy. Although it was packed, Bella gave me the upmost attention and care in answering my multitude of questions regarding merchandise for my dog and potential classes in the future. Aside from discounts for events or deals, I would shop here any-day just for the customer service 10/10.

I unexpectedly rescued two dogs from the street at separate times within a year from each other! Taking both of them to doggie class at BID has truly been the best experience for all of us. With the stresses of life, I love going to school with each of my dogs since it also allows me to have a brain break:) I quickly discovered my dogs are total opposites and have very different training needs. My first rescue Kleo developed some reactivity towards other dogs. Having the exposure to other dogs and having the tools to deal with difficult situations has helped immensely. My second rescue Kaiser is much more reserved, shy, and anxious. He has gained a lot of confidence and now has many outlets to deal with his anxiety. After having taken just about every class they offer, I am much more educated about how my dogs behave and think. I feel much more equipped to handle my dogs in overwhelming situations. The trainers and staff here are incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and will go above and beyond to help in any way they can. Huge shoutout and gratitude to our trainers Stephanie, Megan, Pedram, Valerie, Kate, Alyssa, and Ashley as well as all the other staff behind the front desk/behind the scenes that have helped us along in our journey:) If you’ve been struggling or just want have some fun activities to do with your dog, take a class and experience BID for yourself. You won’t regret it!!!

Reactive Rover Class -

We had such a great experience with the Reactive Rover class! When we started the class, Mullen was reactive toward people, and I wasn’t always sure how to help him feel more confident in those situations. This class taught us so much about understanding his body language, recognizing his threshold, and giving him the tools to make better choices.

What I appreciated most was that his progress was achieved entirely through positive reinforcement. There was no punishment or forcing him into uncomfortable situations. Instead, we learned how to work at his pace, build his confidence, and reinforce the behaviors we wanted to see. It made such a difference for both Mullen and me.

Our trainers were patient, knowledgeable, encouraging, and genuinely invested in helping both the dogs and their humans succeed. We are so proud of how far Mullen has come and feel much more confident continuing his training. I would absolutely recommend Reactive Rover to anyone working through reactivity with their dog!

I can't say enough great things about Believe in Dog! The staff, facilities, and training program have all been incredible. They truly get to know every dog and give each one so much individual attention.
Alyssa was an amazing trainer for our Puppy Class Part 1...her passion for dogs shines through in every class, and she helped our Linguine grow into such a confident, well behaved puppy.
Highly recommend Believe in Dog, and we can't wait to come back for more training!
Wonderful training center! Amazing staff!

Believe in dog (BID) has done so much for me and my dogs! My dogs Rocky and Moose have both struggled with different levels of fear with strangers. It was really hard for me emotionally to see them struggle and not know how to help them. We went in circles trying different training methods. Thankfully, BID has taught us the importance of positive reinforcement. BID has become a safe space for us and it makes me so happy to see Moose flourish with the help of his trainers.

Rocky is next to begin his training here, and he has already benefitted from everything the trainers have taught me and the online resources they have to offer for fear reactive dogs!

A huge shoutout to Alyssa, Megan, Valerie, and Jae for playing a huge roll in teaching me how to manage my crazy Moose who started off as a shy puppy and is now a super energetic and friendly teen. Their passion doesn’t go unnoticed and we are so lucky to have found them for our pups. Don’t hesitate in trusting them to teach you how to use positive reinforcement to build confidence in your dog and strengthen your connection!

What we booked:
- Puppy day school: This program helped him so much through his fear period (major stranger danger). He did so well with socializing when I was worried he wouldn’t, everyone here rocks! :,)

Group classes: These classes are helping him learn to stay calm and focused around distractions (people, other dogs, etc..) while he learns new skills. The classes also help me learn from the trainers! Every trainer has been a dream to work with. Below are the classes we’ve attended.
-Confidence building class
-Basic manners group class
-Intermediate skills group class

Thank you to everyone at BID for being so thoughtful and hard working. We appreciate your patience when teaching us💚

Believe in Dog is easily our Beagles favorite place. All the trainers are amazing, friendly and super patient with all the puppies and dogs.
Not only do they offer great training classes, they also offer fun classes to keep your dog entertained and burn off their energy. Our beagles two favorite fun classes have been Pawfitness and Nosework classes. Valerie & Jae who taught Pawfitness made the class very enjoyable and challenging for the dogs. Our beagle and myself would be tired after the class in a very good way haha. Would recommend Pawfitness and Nosework classes to anyone who wants to have a tired pup after.

I cannot recommend Believe in Dog Training highly enough! A friend told me about it and I'm so glad I tried it. Taking some private classes and then the Reactive Rover course has been incredible. Before we took classes at Believe in Dog, I was discouraged and felt stuck. I didn't know how to handle my dog's bad habits (pulling on the leash, jumping on people, and especially her reactivity towards other dogs). Now she is much calmer and more attentive on walks and I feel confident about how to continue training and working with her using the tools and strategies that I've learned at Believe in Dog.

Trainers are great, and very friendly! We are currently doing some intro classes for our 2 year old mix that we rescued about a year ago, and she is picking everything well. I recommend them if you're considering signing your pup up for training classes.

I can’t recommend this training program enough! As the owner of a pittie mix puppy, it was really important to me to raise her to be a well-mannered, confident dog and help break the stereotypes that often come with her breed. The trainers have been amazing and have helped her flourish in the most positive way.

Everything they teach is based on positive reinforcement, and you can tell they genuinely care about every dog that comes through their doors. They go above and beyond to support both the puppies and their owners, and they make training fun and achievable.

You also have to put in the work at home too! If you stay consistent with what they teach in class, your puppy is absolutely being set up for success. I’m so grateful for everything they’ve done for my girl and would highly recommend them to any puppy owner!

Sad to be moving to another city otherwise I would continue going there!

We have done 3 classes at Believe in Dog: Basic training, intermediate training, and most recently the Fitness class. All were so fun and great for my dog! She gained confidence and we bonded. The Fitness class was great because she stood on different structures, jumped, walked backwards and more. It was also good for her to be in a controlled space with other dogs because she gets a little anxious and this helped boost her confidence.

Doggy Fitness! We just wrapped up the 6 week course of doggy fitness and had the best time. I was a little nervous about the length of class (1.5 hrs), but my pup proved he could do it since it was all about the fun! Our trainers were Valorie and Jae - they were 10/10 helpful! Our pup is a 3 year old whippet. We loved getting new ideas on how to keep our pup tip top while having fun and him learning he has back legs because what even is rear-end awareness? Thank you both for a fun class!

We have done multiple classes at Believe in Dog and each has been better than the next! From basic puppy skills to our most recent class - Doggie Fitness - each has helped teach us (the pawrents and our dogs) new skills and help reinforce old ones. Doggie fitness, one of their speciality classes, has been the most fun as it helped our whippet really step out of his comfort zone to overcome obstacles, challenge his mind, and even learn balance and mobility exercises. We could not recommend BIDs training style and all their classes more highly - we will be back for more!

We love Believe in Dog! We brought our dog, Walker, here to work on his reactivity to other dogs. We loved working with Megan in our 1-on-1. She is extremely knowledgeable about dogs and made us feel very welcome and supported. We also enjoyed attending the Pre-Reactive Rover Class to help practice Walker’s new skills. The facilities are clean and spacious, and there’s lots of great toys and treats in the shop up front. We’ve learned lots of new techniques to help keep Walker calm, confident, and safe when we go out!

We are so happy with our results from the reactive rover training! We learned so many new tools that we can use to better help our dog in her reactive moments. I love how knowledgeable and kind the trainers are! I highly recommend this facility! They use positive reinforcement which is amazing and works! 😊

We took a basic manners class & loved it.  The place is very spacious with fun indoor & outdoor spaces that were always clean. Staff & trainers are helpful & friendly. They also have a nice shop and allow your dog to sample items.

We are so grateful for our experience at Believe in Dog!!
Monty absolutely LOVES going to puppy school and it’s honestly one of his favorite places in the world!! The second he realizes we’re almost there, he gets so excited, and it just makes us so happy to see him so excited to attend Puppy Day school.
We the humans also enrolled in Puppy Class 1 and 2 and the classes gave us so much practical guidance and confidence. The trainers are experienced, calm, and really good at helping you understand your dog in a simple, effective way with lots of positive reinforcement!!

We’re really proud of Monty’s progress. He’s grown so much in confidence, focus, and in how he connects with us. It’s been such a rewarding experience watching him develop.

A very special thank you to all the staff, especially Trainers Jae,Stephanie and Kate for always beings so warm and patient with Monty! Also miss Joanne for always greeting us with so much happiness and kindness!  You could truly tell how much all the staff care about dogs! Monty absolutely ADORES everyone at Believe in Dog. 💜

We’re looking forward to continuing more classes with them. We’re so lucky to have found such a great training facility!

My dog just graduated puppy class 1 and his progress has been amazing. We both learned a lot, and Valerie was an awesome instructor. She immediately noticed my dog was super reactive on day one and came straight to us to offer some tips. I can’t say enough how helpful her advice has been, and her genuine passion for what she does shines through in every class. Can’t wait for puppy class 2!
Valerie was amazing! This class was perfect for our puppy, Champ! We loved all the things we learned and that Champ learned! It was a great experience all around
Valerie was great. She made the training much more manageable. Thanks for helping Dolly!

I cannot say enough positives about this facility or its people.  I wanted to start early puppy training so my GSP started as soon as she met the vaccination requirements around 3 months old and we continued until 8 months.

The team worked with her to develop confidence through socialization, communication and learning basic skills including enrichment activities to help us build and support a solid healthy positive relationship.   We BOTH did our homework and I am extremely happy with the foundation we have to move forward.  While my previous GSPs went to "boot camps" and came back trained and were well loved (and spoiled), we did not develop the level of connection I have with Evey that has come through learning together following the program and doing the homework .

I definitely recommend taking the supplemental classes they offer to help you as the handler learn, practice and hone the techniques.   It truly makes a difference with your relationship with your dog.
HeLi has had an amazing time going through Puppy training and school! She is always so excited to be there with the staff who are exceptional! Can not recommend it enough!

Finn loves Believe in Dog! And we are grateful for the kind, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable staff that has helped us navigate the chaos of puppyhood! We have confident that no matter what he was there for - Puppy Day School, Puppy Class Part 1 or Puppy Class Part 2 - that he was getting top of the line training & attention. The trainers love and treat these dogs like their own and Finn absolutely melts whenever he sees Jae or one of his other trainers from from Puppy Day School. We’ve learned so much about how to help Finn be the best dog at every strip of life. Highly recommend!!

We enrolled our Field Golden Retriever named Moose in the Basic Manners class on Wednesday nights and we had a great time! The class was smaller than expected which was beneficial to us since Moose is a very friendly dog and we were afraid he would be too distracted by the other pups. However, the room is really spacious and they do a good job separating all the dogs.

We really like their teaching methodology as well- which was basically to teach us as parents how to build a relationship with our dog so that he listens to us. We liked it so much that we signed up for the next class that starts mid April.

Valerie was our teacher and we're really happy that she'll be teaching the class in April as well. From the very first class with Moose, we were super impressed by her. She was easily able to get all of the dogs in the class to listen to her commands and explained the lessons very well. Valerie stuck around after class too in case anyone had any questions (we had a lot).

I highly recommend Believe in Dog. It has really worked well for us and Moose.
Love the training classes for puppies.  Such great trainers - so knowledgeable and helpful.

Believe In Dog has truly been the best experience we could’ve had as puppy parents! Our puppy, Mocha, has attended Puppy Day school, puppy training classes and intermediate skills class. It is obvious how much she loves this place and all of her trainers. We as her parents have also enjoyed our experience with her classes and learning so much from all of her trainers. Everyone is so helpful and kind each time we go. If we had to go back and do it all again, we’d choose BIDT every single time.

We HIGHLY recommend the positive/reward based dog training that Believe in Dog teaches. Their staff and trainers are all WONDERFUL and they have a wealth of resources for their customers! We have two Cane Corsos (100+ pound fully grown) and the philosophy taught by Believe in Dog has worked very well. The training and socialization has really worked, plus we have very close bonds with our pups!

I recently finished 12 weeks of classes (Puppy 1 and Puppy 2) with my puppy, taught by Ashley and Jae. They were both so friendly and down-to-earth and distilled a large amount of information into practical, actionable training tasks that were easy to practice outside of class. Dogs, puppies in particular, are unpredictable and how they behave in class doesn’t always represent how they behave at home. Jae did a wonderful job of noticing the moments when owners were disheartened or disappointed and always had an encouraging word to share about what was going well.

I first took classes at BIDT more than 6 years ago. The training philosophy and focus on relationship-building between owner and dog has remained remarkably consistent over the years, despite natural turnover in trainers, which is a testament to Stephanie’s vision and commitment to her team.

We did puppy part one here and loved it! You can tell the staff is really cares about the dogs. I love that they are 100% positive reinforcement in their training. We are gonna start puppy day school and I feel so relieved I can trust them with my fur baby!

I genuinely cannot recommend Believe in Dog enough. As first-time puppy parents, Puppy Day School at BIDT was something we wanted for Solo even before bringing him home, and enrolling him was one of the best decisions we've ever made.

What truly sets BIDT apart is their dedication and care. From the start, the trainers and staff have been so welcoming and are an absolute pleasure to work with. They've helped us feel incredibly supported and reassured during such an impressionable and vulnerable stage of puppyhood. Each dog is treated as an individual and all of the trainers are deeply thoughtful with every interaction. Their authentic passion for setting each dog up for long-term success is evident in their expertise and intentional, structured approach to positive reinforcement-based training.

PDS and Puppy Class Pt. 1 have provided experiences for socialization in a safe, fun, and well-managed environment that go far beyond what we can replicate at home. It has been so rewarding to watch Solo have so much fun with his trainers and puppy friends, grow in confidence, excel in basic obedience, and see his personality flourish over the last 3 months - we couldn't be happier with his progress! Most importantly, it has been an invaluable opportunity to train us, as owners, how to create a lasting bond with our dog.

We can't thank the team at BIDT enough. With their wide variety of different group classes and other training programs offered, we look forward to continuing Solo's training journey as he grows!

I had two dogs in classes at BIDT concurrently this winter, and it is remarkable the change I have seen in both animals.  The training is easy, focused on positive reinforcement, and most importantly effective.  I took in a reactive bulldog and a rescue bulldog with two very different needs and different training modalities.  Both have graduated and we already signed up for more classes! We have been to many dog trainers over the years for various needs - this is the first one that clicked with our dogs, was fun for us as parents to be a part of, and made us want to continue different lessons to increase the quality of life in our home for our bulldogs.  10/10 recommend Megan and Stephanie.  Also there is no better dog treat store in Houston, and no you cannot get what they have on Amazon-but your dogs will go nuts for their stuff.
Thank you for the 5-star review and for promoting positive dog training.

Ah, where to start. This place has been the best experience for George, our now 8-month-old mini dachshund. Between the genuine love from the trainers and staff, and the exposure to other puppies and mentor dogs, he is absolutely obsessed, and so are we.
George has gained so much confidence since starting here. You can tell the team truly cares about every dog, and it shows in how excited he is every time we arrive. We couldn’t have asked for a better training environment and would recommend this place to anyone looking to give their puppy the best possible start.

Special thanks to Kate for the initial 6 week training, Jae for being  his favorite and for being the biggest supporter since day 1, Mar for the fun and greatest report cards.

10/10 would recommend. I have taken adult basic x2 with Megan and I can't stress how great it has been. Not only for my dog but for me as an owner. I have more confidence and tons of fun tools to address anything new my dog throws at me. We are moving up to intermediate soon and hope to continue working with this awesome group of trainers.

Oreo attended puppy day school and was a little shy with other dogs in the beginning but now he is more confident, better behaved, and clearly enjoys the training process. Puppy Class Part One also taught me how to practice the basic cues with Oreo on my own time.

If you are looking for help with training your dog, I HIGHLY recommend Stephanie Bennett’s Believe in Dog training! We were feeling so frustrated about behavior issues our 5 year old dog had developed (especially jumping on people to say hi and reactivity towards other dogs). After just one lesson last week with Megan Gerfen, we have seen a HUGE improvement in our dog’s behavior and best of all, we feel empowered to know how to continue teaching our pupper. We are looking forward to participating in one of the reactive rover classes soon!

Our experience was awesome, there is certanly lots to learn and guidance through it. The fact that they believe in postive reinforcement rather than old school rough teaching makes me feel safer while trainning my pup, Valeria was great with her teaching. I will say this is a method that those require way more patience and practice but is so much more rewarding to see your puppy making right choices on their own and build confidence as they go through life. So excited to be back for Puppy trainning part 2.

Can’t recommend BID enough! My pup is always SO excited to go to class and puppy day school. We have both learned so much while also having fun and meeting great people (both other clients and of course the complete staff)! Pedram was our instructor for Puppy Class Part 1, and he was so great with all of the different pups - so patient and genuinely loves the dogs and what he does. Alyssa helped with a couple one-on-one trainings which were super helpful when I felt stressed with new puppy, and Kate is now our instructor for Puppy Class Part 2 which we are excited for. The facility is also nice and clean. If you are looking for help with your pup, I highly recommend Believe in Dog! <3

My first dog Keeva went here 5 years ago as a puppy. She has become a world competitive  disc dog. She is such a balanced dog I have started my second dog there too and at 14 weeks he is already so confident, well balanced and happy. These people do amazing work with puppies in their puppy day school and puppy group classes!!

We enrolled our sweet Aussie pup at Believe in Dog and our experience has been nothing short of incredible! They have given us the tools and confidence we need to help our dog succeed at home and out in the world. Our pup is now a proud graduate of Puppy Day School as well as the beginner and intermediate group classes. Every trainer we’ve worked with has been fantastic, always leading with love, patience, and genuine care. Each time we drop him off, he bursts with excitement and does the cutest wiggle dance, which shows just how happy he is to see his favorite people (aka the trainers and staff) and his dog pals! We’re truly grateful for everyone and the positive environment they’ve created. We can’t wait to continue with the specialty classes to help him stay happy, social, and well-mannered!!

With love and wiggly tails,
Brisket and Family!
You can get the same information on how to train your dog on YouTube for free. Parking is terrible in the Heights.
Thank you for the 5-star review and for promoting positive dog training.

Bolt is our latest Rhodesian Ridgeback puppy. He is our 4th puppy to train under Stephanie’s program. Believe in Dog is second to none in puppy education, enrichment and socialization. Bolt is enrolled in Puppy Day School, too, for some extra training and enrichment. Bolt’s puppy school trainer was Pedram. He was great with his ability to connect with each puppy, meeting them each at their individual levels of readiness. Believe in Dog has a great shop where we were able to find snuffle mats, high quality treats and food puzzles. Our pack highly recommends Believe in Dog!

Wow… from the moment you step into Believe in Dog, you’ll understand why so many trust and bring their pups here. Can’t say enough good things about their dedication, love and commitment to the pups in their care. Wonderful experience with puppy day school and the in puppy 1 classes. Kona absolutely loves class and going to puppy day school. Special shout out to Pedram who did an amazing job managing pups of different breeds and sizes! We look forward to making many new memories there
got a face harness for my puppy from Stephanie and he LOVES it. his walks have never been easier.
My 2nd dog just graduated from Basic manners. Our trainer Megan was amazing!!! I highly recommend her and the facility!! All the staff are friendly and helpful. Looking forward to our next class!

As a first time Puppy Parent, I was skeptical if I wanted to sign up for classes that will help train my puppy. After browsing through so many different options, I decided to go with Believe in Dog and it’s probably been one of THE best decisions I have ever made.

My pup, Remington, just finished Puppy Class Part One. They teach the basics such as sit, down, leave it, etc and it’s about 6 weeks long, meeting once a week. In those weeks, I have seen such a difference not just in my puppy, but in myself. I feel so much more confident in teaching my dog and exercising all the things we’ve learned in class.

And, I just haaaave to give a HUGE shoutout to both Ms. Kate and Ms. Jae who not only guided us throughout but are genuinely passionate in what they do and it shows immensely in the love they give to the pups who love them just as much.

It’s an investment to have a puppy and I hope if you’re reading this and are on the fence if you should or shouldn’t sign up, one thing is certain — Believe in Dog is worth it.

We can’t wait to sign up for Puppy Class Part Two!
People are great, love my dog and we have learned a lot! We've spent a great deal of time here and the trainers and staff are fabulous
Awesome experience. All the trainers are very knowledgeable and we as dog owners gained valuable skills. I would recommend them to anyone!!!

Our puppy Bingo is OBSESSED with Believe in Dog! From their day school to puppy classes to boutique store, they are the best place to go for training and enrichment. They have the most kind and caring trainers who equip dogs and their humans with the best tools and knowledge to make dogs thrive at home and in the world.

Alyssa, Kate, Megan, and every single trainer that has worked with Bingo has shown her such love and patience. We've done Puppy Class Parts One and Two as well as many days at Puppy Day School. The comfort we felt after our first class was priceless. We have seen Bingo go from a misbehaving little pup to one that is so smart and can get commands and tricks down so quickly. The socialization aspect helped her so much when she wasn't able to go out before receiving all of her shots, and it gave us a jump start on training. I cannot express how patient and caring these trainers are with every puppy and dog that walks through the door!

We will continue to go back to them for more classes and enrichment days because they are the best!

I can’t thank Stephanie enough for everything she’s done for my rescue pup and me. From the moment we walked in, she was kind, patient, and so understanding of my dog’s past. During our private session, she took the time to build trust and made my dog feel safe in a way I didn’t think was possible. You can tell she truly cares and has such a gift for working with animals. I’m beyond grateful for her help—she’s absolutely amazing, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my pup!

We had the best experience in Puppy Class 1 at Believe in Dog! Our trainer, Valerie, was amazing. She was such a great coach to us humans to help us better understand our pup Riley. It was also just fun to watch the pups learn and grow and play together. We will be back for Puppy Class 2.

Believe in Dog is amazing! Megan is such a great trainer -positive, patient and so knowledgeable. The whole team is friendly, helpful, and super professional. Whether you have a new puppy or an older dog, I can't recommend them enough!

Basic manners class with lead trainer Megan was a wonderful and fun experience! She is so patient,  attentive,  extra loving towards the pups, and makes going to class FUN! All while being extremely personable. Our puppy learned so much, we couldn’t be more grateful. Megan is beyond fun!

We have had such a transformative experience at Believe in Dog. From our first private lesson with Megan through our classes with the BIDT team, we have learned so much about how to build trust  and create new experiences for our anxious lil beast. Megan has shown so much enthusiasm and expertise with us and our dog, we are so grateful to get and this community.

We are so grateful to trainer Valerie and the entire team at Believe in Dog for helping us bring out the very best in our rescue dog, Phoebe. We first started taking classes in September 2024 and have continued taking weekly classes throughout the year. Humans and dogs alike have learnt new skills, grown in confidence, and developed a great bond! Valerie is knowledgeable, patient, and positive instructor! We especially job her doggie fitness class and have taken it twice. Looking forward to more classes together!!

Mabel just graduated from Puppy Class part 1 and we could not be happier with her progress or the staff and program at Believe In Dog. Mabel moved from timid to confident in just 6 weeks, and we learned so much about how to keep her on that path (spoiler alert: cheese). Seriously, the skills were broken down so we could understand and teach her the basics as well as some fun tricks. I like that they offer weekend classes which really helps those of us who live in the suburbs or work long hours!

Every time we walk in Believe in Dog we get renewed hope in making it through puppyhood and adolescence with our huge and continuing to grow German Shepherd. Thank you Believe In Dog!! Rocky and his pawrents love everyone who works there. A BIG SHOUT OUT to Stephanie, Megan and Alyssa. Reactive Rover class has really helped all us. And we made it through puppy stage with the Puppy Day School program and continue with Enriched Doggie Day Care with Jessica and Pedram. And of course Joanna has a gift with every dog and great suggestions. It all started with a phone call to Roxanna who helped explain everything and make it easy.

Stephanie said in the first Reactive Rover class "after these classes you WILL see a change in your beloved dogs but for SURE you will see a change in yourselves." Wow! So true.

We thought there would be a magic potion and all would be calm. Nope. But we are making progress and we have all improved. We want to be more comfortable on walks. We want to be less reactive. At first we (us and Rocky) would explode at the smallest sounds. People, lawn mowers, cars and trucks passing by, birds landing on the fence, another dog within 100 yards. Forget about it! Flooding with stimulus does not work with dogs. It only made things worse. We worried other people would think "Man they can't handle their dog." We now know he is not a bad dog and we are not bad pawrents. Quite the opposite. Rocky just wants to love and be loved. He wants to play and the leash or fence is restricting him from running over to other dogs and people.

With the help of Reactive Rover class we are now equipped with tools to help Rocky and especially us. We understand more of what is going on in Rocky's mind and mostly us. Don't be worried about this though because usually most of the classes at BIDT are a few weeks long so you have ample time to complete each resource or homework. Even though most of their resources/homework is all publicly available on their website, it is better to sign your dog up for classes to get the actual experience. Each dog is different and may require tailored training that the resources/homework does not teach you. For example, since my dog is a corgi with short legs, the trainers recommended I teach Charlie the Down command differently than all the other dogs with the usual lure they use. This is also my first time owning a dog/puppy of my own so I am a complete newbie when it comes to general knowledge on dogs. BIDT school brings tremendous value for newbies out there like me because not only does your dog learn, but you do too on general dog knowledge - enrichment types, socialization, life stages of dogs, different types of toys and treats out in the world, etc... Also, I really love BIDT because they do photo ops (first day of school/graduation), provide report cards for Puppy Day School students, and even have their own boutique with items that you cannot find anywhere in the local area (i.e. Pet Deli Liver Loaf, and their own relaxation mat and training pouches). If youre someone that not only wants to learn but also have keepsake/sentimental items, BIDT has got you covered. Lastly, the only thing I would recommend that BIDT to do to improve is to set up their own online store on their website. I see myself moving out of state within the next year and am going to be sad that I wont be able to find Pet Deli Liver Loaf for Charlie in the midwest area.
